test_title: PYST 4: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:13 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

Sonia said, “I have finished my meal.”

options.text: Sonia said that she had finished my meal.
Sonia said that she had finished her meal.
Sonia said that she has finished her meal.
Sonia said that she has finished my meal.

solution:
The correct answer is **"Sonia said that she had finished her meal."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• When converting from direct to reported (indirect) speech, it's important to adjust the verb tense appropriately.
 
• In this case, the present perfect tense **"have finished" **in direct speech typically becomes the past perfect **"had finished" **in reported speech.
 
• Additionally, pronouns must be changed to reflect the shift in perspective from the **first person ("I") **in direct speech to the **third person ("she") **in reported speech.
 
• The possessive pronoun **"my" **needs to be changed to **"her" **to accurately reflect who the meal belongs to in the reported speech.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 2". **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Options 1 and 4 incorrectly retain **"my meal," **which does not accurately reflect the shift in perspective required in reported speech.
 
• Option 3 ("Sonia said that she has finished her meal.") incorrectly maintains the present perfect tense ("has finished"), which should be converted into the past perfect ("had finished") for accurate reported speech.
